statements.quote: This application is open source, and its code can be found in (La Scala, 2024).
Additional details and screenshots can be found in La Scala et al. (2025a) and La Scala et al. (2025b).

Data were gathered from students participating in the study, encompassing both human and AI-generated contributions. Specifically, all ideas created by students were recorded alongside relevant metadata, including author identifiers and timestamps of submission. Likewise, all ideas suggested by the AI peer were logged with corresponding metadata. Furthermore, to assess the usability and perceived effectiveness of the system, participants completed a post-activity questionnaire, which incorporated the Short User Experience Questionnaire (S-UEQ) as well as open questions to capture students’ perceptions of key aspects of the collaborative ideation process.

deposits.notes: The paper's p. 4 Intervention Design statement and p. 16 La Scala (2024) reference identify the intervention application's source code, not the study's analysis code or dataset. This is also the sole URL in forms/c823.json data_and_code.code_url; data_url is empty. The DOI resolved with HTTP 200 to https://zenodo.org/records/14046695. https://zenodo.org/api/records/14046695 returned HTTP 200 and listed one public ZIP, version v3.2.0, published 2024-11-06. Downloaded the entire 1,364,537-byte ZIP in memory from https://zenodo.org/api/records/14046695/files/graasp/graasp-app-collaborative-ideation-v3.2.0.zip/content (HTTP 200). Inspected its complete inventory of 181 non-directory entries and read README.md, LICENSE, test fixtures, mock-response definitions, participant types, and export code. Entries are application source, configuration, documentation, assets, and tests; no empirical CSV, spreadsheet, statistical data file, or analysis notebook was found. cypress/fixtures/appData.ts and src/mocks/mockResponses.ts define synthetic examples; src/mocks/db.ts defines mock accounts. These are not S1 participants or their outputs. src/hooks/utils/export_responses.ts implements CSV export but no exported study data are included. The three has_* flags refer to actual study records, not mock examples or capabilities of the app. studies_covered identifies the application cited for S1, not availability of S1 data. The archive's GitHub release link, https://github.com/graasp/graasp-app-collaborative-ideation/tree/v3.2.0, also returned HTTP 200 with the repository file listing; this mirror is not counted as another deposit. No GitHub API requests were used.

notes: Checked 2026-10-10 using unauthenticated Python urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1. Read the complete markdown conversion (495 lines; all 17 PDF pages, including references; no appendix) and verified the code/materials statements against PDF text on pp. 4, 5, and 16. The PDF has no embedded attachments. There is no explicit study-data availability statement, on-request promise, analysis-code link, preregistration, or S1 supplementary-file link. The p. 5 data-collection passage confirms that author-linked ideas and timestamps were collected; it does not say those records are public. Public software and synthetic test fixtures do not supply those records. The two deposits listed are inspected releases of one software project, not independent data deposits. No public participant/output dataset for S1 was located. Thus none of final.open_items can be resolved from the public data found: allocation counts, distinct analyzed people by arm/outcome after filtering, consent/questionnaire and group-count reconciliation, the score used for originality effects, or group/participant-adjusted effect estimates remain unresolved; cross-paper sample overlap and the assignment procedure also remain unconfirmed. Per-person means, SDs, SEs, analyzed counts, and diversity/homogenization measures cannot be computed from the code archives. Publisher landing page https://aisel.aisnet.org/icis2025/gen_ai/gen_ai/24 returned HTTP 200 (redirecting to a trailing slash); inspected its complete text and links and found only the paper download, with no supplemental data files. Other paper materials links: https://graasp.org/ returned HTTP 200 (general platform homepage); https://doi.org/10.24251/HICSS.2025.041 returned HTTP 200 at https://scholarspace.manoa.hawaii.edu/items/b163fe21-036a-4ab1-b8d0-3724295c4640 (a different paper, listing 0035.pdf); https://doi.org/10.1109/EDUCON62633.2025.11016340 returned HTTP 202 at https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11016340/ with no readable article text. The related papers are cited for system details/screenshots, not as S1 supplements. An author-search candidate, https://zenodo.org/records/17200232, and its API returned HTTP 200 and listed supplementary_material_20250925_02.pdf (182062 bytes, CC-BY-4.0). Read all six PDF pages in memory (download HTTP 200): it contains survey answers, prompt templates, group-designed prompts, and discussion notes from a SEFI workshop in Tampere on 2025-09-17. It explicitly supplements Exploring Collaboration Models for Supporting Ideation with AI Agents (https://zenodo.org/api/records/17631593, HTTP 200; sole file SEFI2025_113.pdf, 558037 bytes). These are different-study records and are excluded from the S1 deposits. DataCite also found the author's 2026 dissertation, DOI 10.5075/epfl-thesis-12164. https://infoscience.epfl.ch/handle/20.500.14299/263786 returned HTTP 200 at https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/publication/725ebaa1-c80f-481b-a111-537c4dfc5e5c. Its landing page lists only EPFL_TH12164.pdf, displayed as 44.92 MB, with no separate dataset or data-sharing link; the PDF was not downloaded because it exceeds the 20 MB limit. Confidence is medium for the negative data search because the dissertation's full text and the blank IEEE response could not be inspected; the code-only classification of the two downloaded archives is directly verified. No login, account creation, access request, or challenge bypass was attempted. Findings concern the checked public sources and do not prove that no unindexed deposit exists.
